parameters.name: HostAddress
parameters.description: The address of the host. You can specify a domain name or an IP address. Only exact matches are supported.

parameters.name: HostName
parameters.description: The name of the host. Only exact matches are supported.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: OSType
parameters.description:
The operating system of the host. Valid values:

- **Linux**

- **Windows**

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page.
The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is used.
> Specify a value for this parameter.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region where the Bastionhost instance resides.

> For more information about regions and zones, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
The source of the host. Valid values:

- **Local**: a local host

- **Ecs**: an ECS instance

parameters.name: SourceInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the ECS instance. Only exact matches are supported.

parameters.name: SourceInstanceState
parameters.description:
The state of the host. Valid values:

- **Normal**: The host is running.

- **Release**: The host is released.
